Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45141]Ballet Body[/url] and GH High Chubby Body

Includes (with recolors): 8 hairstyles, 5 eye types, 10 tops, 2 pants, 4 shoes, 12 accessories.

The difference between the Ballet and GH files is that the pants and shoes are different – the GH versions are slightly wider :)

Installation:

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Extract [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] into your Mods folder.
3. After confirming that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] is working properly, download this mod and extract it into your Mods folder.
4. Launch SMAPI.
